bio.text: Doug McCrory has represented Connecticut's 2nd Senate District since 2017 and previously represented the 7th District in the Connecticut House from 2005 to 2017.
He lost the Democratic primary for re-election on August 11, 2026.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Hartford and graduate degrees from Sacred Heart University and the University of Hartford.
His professional experience includes work as vice principal of Weaver High School and of Lewis Fox Middle School and as a teacher at Sarah J. Rawson Lewis Elementary.
